create_bytes_field: create a BytesField instance to handle variable-length byte arrays for text or raw data
encode_bytes_field: encode a 1D uint8 numpy array into a BytesField by allocating memory and storing pointer and size metadata
build_bytes_decoder: build a BytesDecoder operation that generates a memcpy-based decoder function for batched byte array retrieval
declare_bytes_decoder_state: declare the state and memory allocation for a BytesDecoder with JIT mode and uint8 dtype based on max size
serialize_bytes_field: serialize a BytesField to binary and reconstruct it using from_binary and to_binary methods
